description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * kernel: thermal: core: Fix thermal zone device registration error path (CVE-2026-43332)
  * kernel: macsec: fix replay protection at XPN lower-PN wrap (CVE-2026-63925)
  * kernel: i2c: stub: Reject I2C block transfers with invalid length (CVE-2026-64191)
  * kernel: Kernel SMB client: Double-free vulnerability allows remote denial of service or privilege escalation (CVE-2026-64385)
  * kernel: bpf: Support for hardening against JIT spraying (CVE-2026-64508)
  * kernel: x86/bugs: Enable IBPB flush on BPF JIT allocation (CVE-2026-64507)
  * kernel: openvswitch: fix GSO userspace truncation underflow (CVE-2026-68123)
  * kernel: cifs: validate DFS referral string offsets (CVE-2026-72318)
  * kernel: KVM: arm64: vgic: Check the interrupt is still ours before migrating it (CVE-2026-72289)
  * kernel: af_unix: Unlink scc_entry in unix_del_edge() (CVE-2026-80521)
  * kernel: nvmet-auth: Synchronize timeout work during SQ teardown (CVE-2026-89970)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * net/tls backports for 10.2 (JIRA:AlmaLinux-275027)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
